source: voicefox/source/src/mg/parse.rs:25-56 link-target routing. The first five positive cases and the first two rejected cases are the parse.rs:163-205 inline test vectors verbatim (audit 2026-11-18); the rest are the audit probes run against a verbatim transcription of link_target (cargo test --offline in a standalone harness: 10 passed, 0 failed). Order matters: the playlistId=/musicListId=/playlist|songlist loop (parse.rs:30-38) runs before the album patterns (:39-47), every capture is unanchored (no scheme/host validation, a documented inherited gap), and a bare all-digits string with no '/' always routes to Playlist (parse.rs:49-54).

positive.note: bare numeric share id (分享里常见「复制这段内容…60054701934」): always Playlist, never Song (parse.rs:49-54), so a bare song contentId resolves as a playlist id too
priority probe: the playlistId= loop (parse.rs:30-38) runs before the album patterns (:39-47), so the album path inside the same link loses
resourceId= routes to Album (parse.rs:42) even though the song-metadata endpoint takes a resourceId; there is no link branch that queries a song by resourceId upstream
the album path alternation covers both v3 and v5 (parse.rs:40); the song pattern only matches v3 (parse.rs:27)
unanchored capture: no scheme/host validation upstream, a music.migu.cn fragment inside a foreign query string also matches (documented inherited gap)
